configuration.configs/estimator.yaml:
ukf:
  alpha: 0.15
  beta: 2.0
  kappa: 0.0

initial_std:
  position_m: 5.0
  velocity_mps: 1.0
  attitude_deg: 5.0
  gyro_bias_deg_s: 0.20
  accel_bias_mps2: 0.20

process_std:
  position_m_sqrt_s: 0.05
  velocity_mps_sqrt_s: 0.30
  attitude_deg_sqrt_s: 0.20
  gyro_bias_deg_s_sqrt_s: 0.005
  accel_bias_mps2_sqrt_s: 0.01

nis_alpha: 0.95
configuration.configs/study.yaml:
# Frozen before EC-QAD evaluation. Splits are whole independent trajectories.
seed: 20261108
training_seeds: [7, 19, 43]
conditions: [nominal, gyro_bias, gps_dropout, airspeed_bias]
train_episodes_per_condition: 8
validation_episodes_per_condition: 2
evaluation_episodes_per_condition: 20
duration_s: 180
log_hz: 20
width: 32
teacher_epochs: 180
student_epochs: 100
batch_size: 1024
learning_rate: 0.001
bits: [8, 4, 2]
methods: [uniform, ecqad, covariance, innovation, shuffled, balanced, saliency]
# Train and held-out fault severity intervals are disjoint.
train:
  seed_base: 10000
  onset: [45, 65]
  gyro_deg_s: [0.2, 0.5]
  dropout_s: [8, 15]
  airspeed_mps: [0.5, 1.5]
validation:
  seed_base: 20000
  onset: [68, 78]
  gyro_deg_s: [0.5, 0.65]
  dropout_s: [15, 18]
  airspeed_mps: [1.5, 2.0]
evaluation:
  seed_base: 30000
  onset: [80, 105]
  gyro_deg_s: [0.65, 1.0]
  dropout_s: [18, 25]
  airspeed_mps: [2.0, 3.0]
configuration.configs/controller.yaml:
controller_hz: 50.0
limits:
  max_roll_cmd_deg: 30.0
  max_pitch_cmd_deg: 12.0
  aileron: [-1.0, 1.0]
  elevator: [-1.0, 1.0]
  rudder: [-1.0, 1.0]
  throttle: [0.0, 1.0]

# Starting gains. Tune in experiments/05_truth_control.py before paper experiments.
pid:
  roll:
    kp: 1.8
    ki: 0.10
    kd: 0.35
  pitch:
    kp: -1.5
    ki: -0.08
    kd: -0.30
  heading:
    kp: 0.9
    ki: 0.02
    kd: 0.08
  altitude:
    kp: 0.025
    ki: 0.001
    kd: 0.010
  airspeed:
    kp: 0.08
    ki: 0.015
    kd: 0.01
  yaw_damper:
    kr: 0.25
configuration.configs/sensors.yaml:
seed: 7
rates_hz:
  imu: 100.0
  gps: 5.0
  magnetometer: 20.0
  airspeed: 20.0

noise_std:
  gyro_deg_s: 0.10
  accel_mps2: 0.05
  gps_position_m: [1.5, 1.5, 2.5]
  gps_velocity_mps: [0.10, 0.10, 0.15]
  heading_deg: 1.0
  airspeed_mps: 0.30

initial_bias_std:
  gyro_deg_s: 0.03
  accel_mps2: 0.02
  airspeed_mps: 0.05
configuration.configs/faults.yaml:
faults:
  gyro_bias:
    enabled: false
    start_s: 60.0
    end_s: null
    axis: z
    magnitude_deg_s: 0.5

  gps_dropout:
    enabled: false
    start_s: 60.0
    end_s: 80.0

  airspeed_bias:
    enabled: false
    start_s: 60.0
    end_s: null
    magnitude_mps: 3.0

  aileron_loss_of_effectiveness:
    enabled: false
    start_s: 60.0
    end_s: null
    effectiveness: 0.60
configuration.configs/aircraft.yaml:
aircraft:
  # Loaded from models/jsbsim by default. JSBSIM_ROOT can override the data root;
  # installed stock data remains available for smoke-test fallback.
  model: Rascal110
  fallback_model: c172p
  allow_fallback_for_smoke_test: false

simulation:
  plant_hz: 200.0
  duration_s: 180.0
  initial:
    altitude_m: 300.0
    calibrated_airspeed_mps: 25.0
    heading_deg: 0.0
    flight_path_deg: 0.0
  # The simple-trim request uses JSBSim's simulation/do_simple_trim property.
  trim_before_run: false
  engine_running: false
  motor_startup_ramp_s: 2.0

controls:
  trim:
    aileron: 0.025
    elevator: -0.025
    rudder: 0.0
    throttle: 0.36
